findings.evidence: Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/Dual.lean:48 carries `set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in` immediately above `dotProductEquiv`, so its defeq behaviour is already elaborator-setting sensitive; `dotProductBilin` is a separate structure literal at Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/ToLin.lean:144.
findings.fix: Replace the `change` with an explicit equality: `have : (dotProductBilin ℤ ℤ : (Fin n → ℤ) →ₗ[ℤ] (Fin n → ℤ) →ₗ[ℤ] ℤ) = (dotProductEquiv ℤ (Fin n)).toLinearMap := by ext x y; simp` then `rw [this]; infer_instance`. Both `dotProductBilin` and `dotProductEquiv` are `@[simps]`, so the `ext`/`simp` closes on `x ⬝ᵥ y`. (The same `change` sits at A.lean:251; this PR adds a second copy, so fix it in the shared hoist the description already plans.)
findings.issue: The `IsPerfPair` instance is closed by `change (dotProductEquiv ℤ (Fin n)).toLinearMap.IsPerfPair`, i.e. by defeq across the `LinearEquiv.toLinearMap` wrapper. The comment records that the defeq holds, not that no lemma route exists — and one does.

findings.evidence: `dotProduct` is a plain def (`Mathlib/Data/Matrix/Mul.lean:70`: `def dotProduct v w := ∑ i, v i * w i`) with no reducibility guarantee; Mathlib unfolds it via `simp [dotProduct]` rather than relying on unification.
findings.fix: Unfold explicitly before the congruence (`simp only [dotProduct, typeDWeight]`, or add a `typeDWeight_apply` rfl-lemma) and give `mul_comm` its arguments; or mirror the `two_mul_typeDSimpleRootCoordinates` shape: `conv_rhs => rw [← sum_smul_typeDSimpleRootCoordinates hn y]` then `rw [dotProduct_sum]` and a `simp only` finish.
findings.issue: In `typeDWeight_dotProduct_coordinates` the first calc step applies `Finset.sum_congr rfl` to a goal whose LHS is `typeDWeight n hn x ⬝ᵥ typeDSimpleRootCoordinates n hn y`, silently unfolding `Matrix.dotProduct` to a `Finset.sum`; the step then ends with a bare `rfl` that unfolds the private `typeDWeight`, and `rw [mul_comm]` is unanchored so it rewrites whichever product is found first.

findings.evidence: D.lean:206-208 and D.lean:217-219 are character-for-character the same `rw`/`simp only` pair.
findings.fix: Add `private lemma typeDDoubleCoweight_dotProduct_sum_smul (hn : 4 ≤ n) (c : Fin n → ℤ) (k : Fin n) : typeDDoubleCoweight n k ⬝ᵥ ∑ i : Fin n, c i • typeDSimpleRoot n hn i = 2 * c k` with that proof, then make both callers one-liners (`rw [← …, hg, dotProduct_zero]; omega` and `conv_rhs => rw [← sum_smul_typeDSimpleRootCoordinates hn x]` + the lemma).
findings.issue: `linearIndependent_typeDSimpleRoot` (lines 204-209) and `two_mul_typeDSimpleRootCoordinates` (lines 216-220) contain the same computation verbatim: `rw [dotProduct_sum]` followed by the identical nine-lemma `simp only [dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, typeDDoubleCoweight_dotProduct_typeDSimpleRoot, Fin.val_inj, mul_ite, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, if_true]`. The reusable fact is hidden inside both.

findings.evidence: D.lean:265-269 (`hd`, `hself`, `dotProduct_self_eq_zero.mp`) and D.lean:473-482 (`horth`, `hself`, `dotProduct_self_eq_zero.mp`) are the same three steps with different plumbing.
findings.fix: Extract one private lemma, e.g. `(∀ j, w ⬝ᵥ typeDSimpleRoot n hn j = 0) → w ∈ span of the simple roots → w = 0` (or the `typeDWeight`-phrased version), and derive both: the injectivity via `sum_smul_typeDSimpleRootCoordinates`, the independence via `linearIndependent_typeDSimpleRoot`.
findings.issue: The nondegeneracy argument — a vector orthogonal to every simple root is orthogonal to itself, hence zero by `dotProduct_self_eq_zero` — is written out twice, in `typeDWeight_injective` (258-269) and again in `linearIndependent_root_typeDSimpleIndex` (470-482). Both are the single fact that `typeDWeight` has trivial kernel on the span of the simple roots.

summary: Proofs are mostly robust (split_ifs/omega case analysis, explicit branch lemmas), but two spots rest on undocumented definitional unfolding of Mathlib wrappers and two identical computations are inlined twice instead of factored.
